Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the third turn (Step 3) by misidentifying the father of Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart. The WebSurfer correctly identified the father as "John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart" (who was the 2nd Marquess of Bute, not the 1st), but the Planner incorrectly stated in its analysis and subsequent instructions that the father was "John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute". This error propagated through the conversation, leading the WebSurfer to search for the wrong person (the 1st Marquess, who died in 1814) instead of the correct person (the 2nd Marquess, who died on 22 January 1794). The Planner failed to correctly interpret the genealogical relationship presented in the search results, confusing the 1st Marquess (the grandfather) with the 2nd Marquess (the father).
